author: Angel Ayala
text: Mark was phenomenal was on time was priced well. Did the work did the cleanup and was a professional the entire time. I can’t say enough how much I recommend this Septic company best in Seminole County.

author: Brandon Lloyd
text:

author: Shawn Meece
text: I don’t make a lot of reviews myself but I really have to brag on Mark Johnson‘s company! When I say he gave me the best price and did the best job that I could’ve ever imagined it’s an understatement. He really saved me a lot of headache and he did everything he said he was going to. He came two days after I called. Installed the needed 500 sq ft of drain field and had it inspected and covered in a one day.  Amazing guy too, very professional told me things I didn’t even know. Great job Mark thank you 👍

author: Asun Obregon
text: Mark resolved our issue of replacing our sewer grinder pump the same day we contacted him, keeping us informed of the process.

author: Ryan OConnor
text: I received exemplary service from Johnson Septic Service. Frank supported our routine septic pump service. He was friendly and thorough. It was a pleasure chatting with him. He went above and beyond by back flushing our tank a few times to ensure the job was completed sufficiently. Highly recommended!!
